title: Count Elements With Maximum Frequency
summary: Given an array of positive integers, return the combined frequency of elements that occur most frequently.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, return the combined frequency of elements that occur most frequently.
constraints: Count the frequency of every distinct value.
Find the largest frequency attained by any value.
Return the total number of array elements belonging to values with that maximum frequency.
hints: A frequency table groups all equal elements.
Add the full count for every key tied at that maximum.
The qualifying groups are disjoint and their stored counts equal their numbers of elements, so the sum is exact.
editorial: The qualifying groups are disjoint and their stored counts equal their numbers of elements, so the sum is exact.

tests.explanation: One and two each occur twice, so their four elements are counted.
Every value has maximum frequency one, so all five elements count.
